concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-in-person-payments-surcharge]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Platforms POS surcharge guide for configuration/dynamic methods, liable/user booking, compliance and DCC limits, and per-split webhook/report reconciliation.
warnings: Dated country and legal examples do not prove current eligibility or compliance; the feature has no automated global enforcement, and standalone terminals only support configured surcharges.
Surcharge cannot apply to authorization adjustments or overcaptures or to the same transaction as DCC; v1.112+ skips DCC when surcharge is positive.
Illustrative authorization and balance-account webhooks do not prove capture, payout or bank receipt.
